reports.title: Loess Bluffs habitat and waterfowl survey

scope.name: Loess Bluffs National Wildlife Refuge
scope.description: Refuge waterfowl use reported by staff; the marker identifies the refuge, not the exact location of a flock or a surveyed polygon.

marker.sourceField: HTML meta geo.position and embedded geodata POINT

reports.method: IWMM area, block or modified block count estimates; habitat rated using visual estimates. The report labels each bird-count column as the week of its date.

provenance.species: PDF pages 1-2, Waterfowl Species Summary; columns 10/06/2026, 10/13/2026, 10/20/2026, 10/27/2026.
provenance.groups: PDF page 2, Species Group Summary; row All Ducks.
provenance.habitat: PDF page 1, Habitat Conditions Summary; rows Habitat Conditions Rating, Acres of wetlands flooded, Percentage of Wetlands Frozen.

notes: All Ducks is the agency's duck-group total, not a sum of the selected species in counts. Geese, swans, coots and grebes must not be added to it.
These are dated refuge estimates and can change with habitat, observation and local movements; they do not prove a southbound migration arrival or predict a nearby hunter's success.

provenance.totals: PDF page 3, Fall Migration Waterfowl Survey, Week Ending October 30, 2026; Total row under Ducks/Abundance and Ducks/Composition (%).
provenance.speciesChange: PDF page 3, Species / % Change in count from Previous Week; Mallard row.

summary.changePercentSource: Agency-reported figures, not recomputed species counts from rounded percentages.

notes: Do not multiply the rounded 16% composition by 69,133 and present the result as an exact mallard count. The report provides mallard percentage change, but not a separate exact mallard total in this table.
The report shows total ducks increasing while mallards decreased 3.1%; a total-duck change is not a mallard movement signal.
Saylorville is missing, not zero. Spirit Lake has no previous-week count, so the reported total change is not automatically a matched-site comparison.
No individual survey-site coordinates or geographic survey polygons were verified in this audit.
